structurePatterns.layout: flex row, gap-3, align-center, full width on mobile / max-width on desktop
structurePatterns.borders: 1px solid var(--border) with left 3px accent border

pixelVariant.border: var(--sh-px) hard 2px accent edge when pixelStyle=pixel
pixelVariant.degrade: without --font-pixel, tag falls back to var(--font-mono)

usageHints.whenToUse: Feedback after user actions, async operation completion, form errors
usageHints.accessibility: Use role=status/alert; include close button with aria-label
usageHints.doNot: Do not stack more than 3 toasts; avoid persistent toasts without dismissal

pixelLayer.scope: left accent edge + variant tag only
pixelLayer.note: Pixel fusion only swaps the toast's left accent border to a hard offset shadow (var(--sh-px)) and the variant tag to Fusion Pixel. Body stays editorial.
